source.citation: M. Loretz et al., Spurious harmonic response of multipulse quantum sensing sequences, Physical Review X 5, 021009 (2015).

analysis_policy.baseline: for each acquisition segment, median of the first and last 20% of samples, with at least three samples from each end
analysis_policy.response: maximum of transition_probability minus segment baseline and zero
analysis_policy.normalization: one global maximum across all baseline-corrected experimental segments
analysis_policy.connectivity: one-dimensional adjacency within each acquisition segment; gaps between segments are never bridged
analysis_policy.purpose: separate test that connected-region persistence detects multiple fundamental and spurious XY8 resonances

digitization_policy.method: extract experimental polyline vertices from the vector PDF in the arXiv source archive
digitization_policy.error_scope: digitization only; no experimental error bars are reported for the plotted spectrum

separation_guardrail: This irregular multi-acquisition spectrum is a pulse-error and harmonic-resonance mechanism check. It is not combined with DeVience, Pham, or the project's 200 kHz operating-point validation.
